ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Idle`. Its transition is delayed, so nothing is measured yet.
`Idle` → `Measure` → `Report` → `Idle`, all in this tick. The reading is 20, so `Measure` takes its second transition, nobody emits `high`, and `Report` does not emit `alarm`.
130 is over 100: `Measure`'s first transition emits `high`. Later in the same chain `Report` tests `high`, finds it present, and emits `alarm`.
The reading is still 130 (inputs keep their value), so the chain runs the same way again: `high` and `alarm` are present in this tick too.
`high` was present in tick 4, but a local signal is absent again at the start of every tick. Nobody emits it now, so there is no `alarm`.
